title: Columbia TV threatens to 'burn your negative' over the Men in Black suits in the Dark Skies pilot

tellings.quote: an it's seared in my head. He says, "Get your guys, get no, get your actors out of the black suits today or we will shut down your production and burn your negative." [gasps]

plain: Bryce Zabel, a television writer and producer, says that around 1995, while making the first episode of his UFO drama series Dark Skies, he got a threat from the Columbia TV studio in Los Angeles. He says he was told to get his actors out of their black suits, the look of the secret agents known as Men in Black, that very day, or the studio would shut down the production and burn the film. He links this to Steven Spielberg's company Amblin and director Barry Sonnenfeld, and tells it as a memory seared into his head.
